title: cogswellia triternata var. alata
intro: Cogswellia triternata var. alata, commonly known as Cogswell's thistle or prickly thistle, is a flowering plant species native to South Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which have been identified to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
